content: .{@-चर्यम्@} .²1 religious studentship, the life of celibacy passed by a Brāhmaṇa boy in studying the Vedas, the first stage or order of his life; अविप्लुतब्रह्मचर्यो गृहस्थाश्रममाचरेत् <ls>Ms. 3. 2</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">2. 249</ls>; <ls>Mv. 1. 24</ls>; यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति तत्ते पदं संग्रहेण ब्रवीम्योमित्येतत् <ls>Kaṭh.</ls> .²2 religious study, self-restraint. .²3 celibacy, chastity, abstinence, continence; also ब्रह्मचर्याश्रम. . ({@-र्यः@}) a religious student; see ब्रह्मचारिन्. . ({@-र्या@}) chastity, celibacy.
